info.name: DNSFilter Agent Local User Bulk Deletes User Agents API

params.name: agent_local_user_uuids
params.description: Filter to roaming clients associated with these users. When cybersight_enabled=true uses Cybersight activity (OpenSearch); otherwise uses current user on device (PG).

params.name: agent_state
params.description: filter by agent state

params.name: agent_type
params.description: Filter user agents by agent type. Valid values: windows, macos, ios, android, chrome. Valid operators: is, isnot

params.name: agent_version
params.description: Filter user agents by agent version. Valid operators: startswith, equals, doesnotequal, contains, doesnotcontain, endswith

params.name: auto_update
params.description: Filter user agents by their organization's auto update value

params.name: block_page_id
params.description: Filter user agents by block page ID

params.name: browser_extension_status
params.description: Filter by browser extension status (chrome or edge). Valid values: installed, not_responding, not_installed. Valid operators: is, isnot

params.name: cybersight_enabled
params.description: When true, use OpenSearch for Cybersight activity in the time window: with agent_local_user_uuids, filter to roaming clients linked to those users; without, filter to roaming clients with activity on Cybersight-eligible agents in scope. When false, use Postgres only (default: false)

params.name: cybersight_status
params.description: Filter by CyberSight service status. Valid values: active, inactive, disabled, not_available. Valid operators: is, isnot

params.name: end_at
params.description: ISO8601 end of activity window. Optional; only used with start_at when cybersight_enabled=true.

params.name: msp_id
params.description: MSP ID, set scope to all sub-orgs

params.name: name_search
params.description: Filter user agent by client name fields (i.e. hostname and friendly_name). Valid operators: contains, doesnotcontain

params.name: network_ids
params.description: Networks IDs, defaults to all

params.name: new_agent_states
params.description: assign user agents new agent states: Protected, Unprotected, Offline

params.name: organization_ids
params.description: Organization IDs, defaults to user organization ID

params.name: page
params.description: Page number and size

params.name: policy_id
params.description: Filter user agents by policy ID

params.name: policy_schedule
params.description: Filter user agents by policy/schedule name

params.name: release_channels
params.description: Filter user agents by release channel. Valid values: stable, beta, preview. Valid operators: is, isnot

params.name: scheduled_policy_id
params.description: Filter user agents by scheduled_policy ID

params.name: search
params.description: User agent list by keyword(s) (space delimited), this could be: status, hostname, friendly name, current logged in user

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort options, valid attributes: hostname, friendly_name, agent_version, last_sync, agent_state, vpn_status, private_network (connected, not_connected, disabled)

params.name: start_at
params.description: ISO8601 start of activity window. Optional; only used when cybersight_enabled=true. Omitted => last 91 days unless paired with end_at.

params.name: state
params.description: filter by user agent online/offline state

params.name: status
params.description: filter by user agent status, valid attributes: active, disabled, uninstalled, uninstall_queued, uninstalling

params.name: tags
params.description: User agent list by tags

params.name: traffic_received_last_15_mins
params.description: filter by agents that have received traffic in last 15 minutes

params.name: type
params.description: User agent type, defaults to non-proxy/no-relays user agents

params.name: vpn_mode
params.description: Filter by VPN mode (agent-level overrides org-level). Valid values: manual, always_on. Valid operators: is, isnot

params.name: vpn_status
params.description: Filter by VPN connectivity status. Valid values: connected, not_connected, disabled. Valid operators: is, isnot
